routes.target: f_G and env4, jointly ~82% of the radius sum S

routes.kill_reason: the one real order-3 probe that ran is at CUSUM cell 0, drift e ~ 0. The tail cells are at e in [1.70, 2.09]. An order-3 value at e ~ 0 constrains nothing at e ~ 2 without a transport argument across the whole drift range, and no certified such transport exists.
routes.mechanism: reuse already-certified order-3 evidence (the first real probe, T-EXT, the GammaTilde point certificate)

routes.inputs: k, j, sup_S0, aux.candidate_suprema, aux.midpoint_eps -- all committed

routes.mechanism: tighten sigma3, the (P3') midpoint source tower
routes.not_refuted_note: the oracle CLOSES cell 307, so A5 is NOT refuted there; at 307 the binding reason is DATA -- sigma3 is already at the min of the pure tower and the adopted measurement, and no committed artifact offers a tighter one

routes.inputs: an order-4 measurement of the source, i.e. sup ||S_r''''||

routes.not_refuted_note: the oracle CLOSES cell 307, so A6 is NOT refuted there; at 307 the binding reason is NEW_REAL -- tightening sigma4 needs an order-4 measurement of the source, and none exists

routes.inputs: new K1 records at new, finer cells
routes.kill_reason: rho is the K1 cover cell half-width. Reducing it means certifying the objects on new, narrower cells, which is a new K1 numerical cell at a previously unevaluated address. Forbidden outright. This is the single largest lever found and it is a live FUTURE route.
routes.max_gain: oracle: rho halved closes all three open cells
routes.mechanism: refine the cover: narrower cells, smaller rho
routes.target: rho, which enters both the Taylor transport and the penalty

routes.kill_reason: R_interval and D_interval are certified AT THE MIDPOINT e0 only (cusum_layer2: delta_mid). Applying the clause at a different sub-midpoint needs R and D there, and transporting them costs exactly what the split saves, because the transport of R' needs the same R'' bound.
routes.mechanism: split the K5-B clause over sub-intervals of the existing cell, transporting R and D from e0 to each sub-midpoint

routes.inputs: g(e0) enclosure and the whole-cell R'' enclosure -- both already certified
routes.max_gain: 1.211% to 1.295% of the penalty; closes nothing
routes.mechanism: exact-weight, sign-aware transport (theorem C5-T): replace the penalty rho*x_hi*M by max((-H_lo)^+ * rho*(x_hi - rho/2), (H_hi)^+ * rho*(x_lo + rho/2))
routes.target: the transport constant in the K5-B direct clause

routes.kill_reason: max(|H_lo|, |H_hi|) equals max((H_hi)^+, (-H_lo)^+) identically, for a one-signed or a zero-straddling enclosure alike. Sign-awareness pays only when combined with DIFFERENT directional weights, which is what D1 supplies, and even then only when the POSITIVE end dominates. On all four tail cells the negative end dominates.
routes.mechanism: sign-awareness alone, keeping the weight rho*x_hi

routes.inputs: a tight midpoint enclosure of R'' and a whole-cell bound on R'''
routes.kill_reason: the second-order remainder needs R''', which is precisely the order-3 quantity the whole programme lacks. Circular.
routes.mechanism: second-order transport of g using g'(e0) = -e0 R''(e0)

routes.inputs: joint certified information about R and D
routes.kill_reason: R_interval and D_interval are sealed independently certified intervals in the adopted K1 record. No joint/correlation information is committed, and manufacturing it means re-certifying the K1 objects.
routes.mechanism: tighten g_hi = R.hi - e0*D.lo by exploiting correlation between the R and D enclosures
routes.target: g_hi, which is 59-60% of the closure deficit

routes.reopened_because: the first version of this ledger killed E2 as MATH / zero verdict value, in the SAME commit in which C5-T consumed 63% of the very margin it said needed no defence. Doubly wrong: the 308 leg rested on C4's UNCERTIFIED Monte-Carlo, which a MATH kill may not do, and the 309 leg is contradicted by C5's own result. Under C5-T the cell-309 exclusion stands on 0.94% of critical-A0 margin, down from 2.58%, and a sharper CERTIFIED lower bound on Lambda_309 is the only lever that restores it. Re-opened on the pre-forecast review's instruction (item C). C5 does NOT execute it -- the gate is frozen on route D1 and adding a mechanism after freeze would be scope creep -- and it is the top recommendation to the successor.
